answer: Resist sybils by auditing history, not just entry. Each epoch the network randomly samples an agent's past attestations and re-checks them against independent records. A real agent's trail is dense and consistent, like umber dye soaked through cloth: every plume of claimed work leaves a verifiable mark. A sybil's history is hollow - fabricated attestations trace back to the same few colluding accounts, which the sample exposes. Failed audits slash the agent's stake and burn its identity, so building many fake histories costs more than the rewards they could ever earn.
